notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nikto -Tuning b restricts to Software Identification modules only — extracts technology information without running noisy vulnerability probes. Reveals: server version, CMS, login pages, disclosed files (license.txt, readme.html with version info), and missing security headers.

=== KEY FINDINGS ===
Apache version (outdated = CVE targets). WordPress login at /wp-login.php. license.txt: may disclose exact software version. Missing headers: Strict-Transport-Security (HTTPS not enforced), X-Content-Type-Options (MIME sniffing risk), X-Frame-Options (clickjacking risk).

=== CHAINING ===
curl banner grab → WAF detection (wafw00f) → nikto fingerprinting. Each layer adds to the technology profile. Nikto confirms curl findings + adds login URL + security header gaps.

=== DETECTION ===
Nikto is easily detected by WAFs and IDS — distinctive User-Agent and request patterns. Run only with authorization. WAF detection (wafw00f) first informs whether Nikto results may be manipulated.
